garden_source: Garden v15.2 + SCEP v1.1 merged candidate (2026-09-12)
title: Typed verifier bridge
objective: Implement a verifier registry/adapter layer that records exactly what each checker establishes and refuses to treat compile success, formal proof, empirical evidence, or security tests as interchangeable.
required_outputs: test adapters using local deterministic fixtures
acceptance: A checker result is scoped to its verifier class and assumptions; unpinned or candidate-owned protected verifiers cannot produce admission receipts.
